# TradeGrowth Marketing

> The AI-powered growth engine for UK trades and local service businesses — get
> found, get booked, and get recommended by AI. We help UK trades (electricians,
> plumbers, gas engineers, roofers, builders, joiners and others) and local
> service businesses (cleaning companies, landscapers, mobile mechanics, salons,
> personal trainers and similar) get named inside AI-generated answers, then make
> sure the resulting enquiries actually convert into booked work.

Website: https://tradegrowthseo.com
Contact: contact@tradegrowthseo.com
Coverage: United Kingdom, remote-first
Serves: UK trades and local service businesses (not national brands or ecommerce)
Availability: One client per trade or service, per area

## What we do

- **Website design** — 10-page, mobile-first websites built AEO-ready from day
  one. £1,500 one-off. Domain registered in the client's name; hosting and SSL
  included for the first year.
- **SEO + AEO** (headline service) — local SEO and Google Business Profile
  management, plus Answer Engine Optimisation to get clients cited and
  recommended inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google AI Overviews.
- **Google & Meta ads** — Google-led paid acquisition, because search intent
  converts better. Ad spend is paid by the client directly to the platforms.
- **Industry-specific CRM** — configured per sector. For trades: EICR and gas
  safety records, materials/labour split for VAT, job costing, van stock and
  compliance certificate tracking. For service businesses: recurring bookings,
  deposits, no-show chasing and repeat-customer reminders.
- **Done-for-you sales** — an AI voice agent answering missed calls within three
  rings 24/7, plus a human appointment setter chasing quotes at 48 hours, 5, 10,
  20 and 30 days.
- **The Trades Network** — a closed referral network between clients (trades and
  local service businesses alike), with one-click referrals, a £25–50 finder's
  fee and quarterly meetups. One client per trade or service, per area, so no
  member ever refers work to a competitor.

## Pricing (published in full)

- The Website: £1,500 one-off (50% deposit, 50% on launch). No monthly commitment.
- Basic: £300/month + £150 setup. 3 month minimum.
- Standard: £600/month + £300 setup. 3 month minimum. Most popular.
- Premium: £1,200/month + £500 setup. 6 month minimum.

Each monthly package includes everything in the tier below it. Full comparison:
https://tradegrowthseo.com/pricing/

## Guarantee

Double-your-money guarantee: if the work doesn't return at least double what the
client has paid, we keep working at no charge until it does.
